label: Janet: attach to REPL kernel
command: janet -e '(import spork/netrepl) (defn project [d] (cond (or (os/stat (string d "/.git")) (os/stat (string d "/project.janet"))) d (if-let [i (last (string/find-all "/" d))] (if (> i 0) (project (string/slice d 0 i)))))) (def here (os/realpath ".")) (def root (string/triml (string/replace-all ":" "" (or (project here) here)) "/\\")) (def dir (string (or (os/getenv "HOME") (os/getenv "USERPROFILE")) "/.cache/janet-zed/repl/" root)) (defn read [name] (string/trim (slurp (string dir "/" name)))) (netrepl/client "127.0.0.1" (read "port") (string (read "token") "term"))'
